title: Nova Fought Her Own Shadow
description: Her shadow moved first. So she made it bow. #stickfigure #stickfight #shadow #animation #shorts
topic: INK-07 stick-fight Short: under a desk lamp, Nova duels her own shadow and wins on its delay

snippets.STYLE: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. Consistent glossy 3D render in every frame, never flat 2D. Each face is only two small glowing eye-dots: no mouth, no nose, no teeth, no brows, no smile. Hands end in at most three rounded nubs. Every figure is a separate, distinct body with clear space around it; bodies never fuse or merge. Hits burst into dry puffs of ink dust and glassy sparks, never blood or splatter.
snippets.NOVA: NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eye-dots and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, holding a glowing magenta bo staff in her right hand.
snippets.SHADOW_WALL: SHADOW: Nova's own cast shadow on the lamp-lit plaster wall, a crisp flat pure-black silhouette with the same topknot and bo-staff outline, no rim light, no glow, no eyes.
snippets.SHADOW_FREE: SHADOW: Nova's shadow peeled off the wall and standing free, a paper-thin pure matte-black silhouette figure with Nova's exact outline and topknot, holding a black shadow-staff in its left hand as her mirror image, two tiny dim charcoal eye-dots, no rim light, no glow, a real thin 3D body lit and shaded by the lamp.
snippets.SET: In a dark night study, a single brass desk lamp on a wooden desk throws a hard warm cone of light across a bare pale plaster wall, bookshelves fading into deep shadow, dust motes drifting in the lamp beam, blank unmarked surfaces
snippets.AVOID: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, eyebrows, smiles, human faces, skin, hair, realistic human hands, fingers beyond three rounded nubs, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, extra characters, fused or merged bodies, blood, gore, splatter, red liquid, flat 2D cartoon look, flat or empty backgrounds.
snippets.SOUL: stick figure, NOT a human, no face, no mouth, only two glowing eye-dots, no skin, no clothing except listed accessory. Vertical 9:16 frame.
snippets.DRIPTINK: a single glossy ink drip falling and landing, followed by one bright crisp glass tink, clean and close
snippets.AMB: quiet night study room tone: soft electric hum of a desk lamp bulb, a slow ticking clock, seamless
snippets.DUEL: stick-figure staff duel: fast staff whooshes, sharp wooden clacks doubled like a perfect echo, bright glassy tinks, no flesh hits
snippets.BED: tense koto-synth and low taiko duel rhythm, mirrored call-and-response phrases, instrumental

qc: INK-07: CS4 at 9:16 is unverified; if S3-S5/S7-S8 fail aspect or look, re-roll on hf-seedance-2-5 (SDi 9:16) from a keyframe. Peel control: S2 is Seedance with an endFrame prompt (shadow free-standing, wall bare); reject if the shadow stays on the wall AND stands free at once (a doubled shadow), or if it fuses with Nova. Shadow: flat pure black on the wall (S1, S2 start, S9); free-standing thin matte figure with mirror-image staff in its LEFT hand (S2 end-S8); never gets a rim light or magenta. Drift: Nova's glowing magenta bo staff always in her RIGHT hand; topknot and magenta rim every shot. Lore: faint crimson eye glint on the shadow for ONE beat in S6 only (~7.5 s, synced to the detuned music box); reject crimson anywhere else. Faces: eye-dots only; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows or smile even 1 frame = reject. Hands: max three rounded nubs. Hits = ink dust + glassy sparks, never blood/splatter. Style: glossy 3D room, never flat 2D (the only flat element is the cast shadow on the wall); wall and books blank. Labels: score counter only, top, never over faces; 0 : 0 through the duel, 1 : 0 at the S8 tap (retime to the burst frame), resets to 0 : 0 when the shadow returns in S9. Audio: room-tone bed under every section, no silence > 1.5 s; drip-tink at 0.0. Seam: loop S9 end (wrong-way shadow) = S1 keyframe (endFrame fromSection 0). Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory = re-roll; 3rd or fused limb >=3 frames = re-roll; lost rim light or flat bg = re-roll. Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
